Messages.Author: Ron de Langen
Messages.Body:
Question: I have just blocked, the acting minion plays a dodge for his
strike, I play Scorpion Sting (at Superior, can not be dodged) Does
acting minion choose a new strike or does his dodge just fail?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Messages.Body: It fails. The cards wording always takes effect.
